question: Which state launched 'Araku Kouni', a first-of-its-kind tribal millet-based food menu, to promote tribal culinary heritage?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **CM N. Chandrababu Naidu launched ‘Araku Kouni’, the state’s first tribal millet-based menu, at the Secretariat in Guntur.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Origin:** The ingredients are sourced from the **Alluri Sitarama Raju (ASR)** district, grown naturally without chemical fertilizers.
 
• **Dishes:** The menu features traditional items like **Korra Payasam, Ragi Chapati, Samala Pulihora,** and **Corn Vada**.
 
• **Partnership:** Developed by the ASR district administration with technical support from the **Indian Culinary Institute, Tirupati**.
 
• **Distribution:** The **AP Tourism Development Corporation (APTDC)** will serve this menu in its 'Haritha' restaurants.
 
• **Aim:** To provide sustainable livelihoods to tribal farmers and mainstream the nutritional benefits of millets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Araku Valley__

 __
 
• Located in the ASR district of Andhra Pradesh, it is famous for its coffee and rich tribal culture, primarily inhabited by the Bagata, Valmiki, and Kondh tribes.
 
 
 
• Millets (Shree Anna)__
 
 
• Millets are highly nutritious, gluten-free, and climate-resilient crops. India is one of the world's leading producers of millets.
